verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Databricks serves an llms.txt at https://docs.databricks.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured header describing its platform documentation, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The evidence covers only the existence and heading of this file, not its depth or any further agent-oriented doc formats. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's coverage and depth, an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and first-party documentation describing agent-oriented docs usage.
